title: content/MANIFEST.json (schema version 1)
description: Minimal provenance manifest defined in sub-chunk 1.1.3. Sub-chunk 4.1.1 ADDS fields to asset entries; it never renames, removes or redefines a v1 field, and a v1 manifest must always validate against every later schema.

path.description: Relative to content/. Forward slashes, no leading slash, no '..' segment.

licence.description: SPDX identifier of the asset's licence, or 'proprietary' for assets we authored or generated. Must be on the allowlist in tools/licence/policy.yaml; any non-commercial licence fails the build.
